scripts.admin:promote: npm run build:packages && npm run admin:promote --workspace @commuteshare/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @commuteshare/api && npm run build --workspace @commuteshare/worker
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @commuteshare/config && npm run build --workspace @commuteshare/database
scripts.build:web: npm install --prefix apps/mobile --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build:web --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @commuteshare/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @commuteshare/worker
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:packages && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
